Respondent
FINAL DECISION - DISMISSAL
Petitioner Hill filed an appeal asking that certain payments be treated as regular
compensation. On October 16, 2024, I sent him an order to show cause why his appeal should not
be dismissed due to his failure to submit a prehearing memorandum by August 5, 2024 as ordered.
I gave him until November 15, 2024 to respond. No response was received.
Accordingly, this appeal is dismissed for failure to prosecute. 801 CMR l.01(7)(g)3.
DIVISION OF ADMINISTRATIVE LAW APPEALS
James P. Rooney
First Administrative Magistrate
